Task: Bulk Modulus of Copper
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of copper by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for copper. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)

1. Uses the EAM potential for copper
2. Applies small deformations

{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/copper_bulk_modulus_trial_4/in.elastic", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Cu.data

# Define potential
pair_style eam
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Cu_u3.eam

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Set up elastic calculation
change_box all triclinic

# Calculate elastic constants
fix 1 all box/relax aniso 0.0

# Define the elastic constants calculation
variable up equal 1.0e-6
variable down equal -${up}

# Output
variable tmp equal "lx"
variable L0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal "ly"
variable L1 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal "lz"
variable L2 equal ${tmp}

# Define 6 deformation components
variable d1 equal "(${L0}*(1.0+${up})-${L0})/(${L0})"
variable d2 equal "(${L1}*(1.0+${up})-${L1})/(${L1})"
variable d3 equal "(${L2}*(1.0+${up})-${L2})/(${L2})"
variable d4 equal "(${L1}*${up})/(${L1})"
variable d5 equal "(${L2}*${up})/(${L2})"
variable d6 equal "(${L0}*${up})/(${L0})"

# Define stress components
variable p1 equal "v_d1*c_thermo_press[1]"
variable p2 equal "v_d2*c_thermo_press[2]"
variable p3 equal "v_d3*c_thermo_press[3]"
variable p4 equal "v_d4*c_thermo_press[4]"
variable p5 equal "v_d5*c_thermo_press[5]"
variable p6 equal "v_d6*c_thermo_press[6]"

# Output elastic constants
fix def1 all print 1 "${d1} ${p1}" file strain1.txt
fix def2 all print 1 "${d2} ${p2}" file strain2.txt
fix def3 all print 1 "${d3} ${p3}" file strain3.txt
fix def4 all print 1 "${d4} ${p4}" file strain4.txt
fix def5 all print 1 "${d5} ${p5}" file strain5.txt
fix def6 all print 1 "${d6} ${p6}" file strain6.txt

# Apply deformations and calculate stresses
variable i loop 6
  label loop_start
  if "$i == 1" then &
    "change_box all x delta 0 ${up} xy delta ${up} xz delta ${up} remap units box"
  if "$i == 2" then &
    "change_box all y delta 0 ${up} yz delta ${up} remap units box"
  if "$i == 3" then &
    "change_box all z delta 0 ${up} remap units box"
  if "$i == 4" then &
    "change_box all yz delta ${up} remap units box"
  if "$i == 5" then &
    "change_box all xz delta ${up} remap units box"
  if "$i == 6" then &
    "change_box all xy delta ${up} remap units box"
  
  run 0
  next i
  jump SELF loop_start

print "All done""}

{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/copper_bulk_modulus_trial_4/in.elastic", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Cu.data

# Define potential
pair_style eam
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Cu_u3.eam

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Setup for elastic constant calculation
variable up equal 1.0e-6
variable down equal -${up}

# Store initial box lengths
variable tmp equal lx
variable L0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal ly
variable L1 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal lz
variable L2 equal ${tmp}

# Compute elastic constants
variable step equal 0

# C11
variable step equal ${step}+1
variable dir equal 1
fix 1 all deform 1 x scale 1.0001 remap x
run 1
variable C11 equal -((c_thermo_press[1])-0)/(0.0001)
unfix 1

# C22
variable step equal ${step}+1
fix 1 all deform 1 y scale 1.0001 remap x
run 1
variable C22 equal -((c_thermo_press[2])-0)/(0.0001)
unfix 1

# C33
variable step equal ${step}+1
fix 1 all deform 1 z scale 1.0001 remap x
run 1
variable C33 equal -((c_thermo_press[3])-0)/(0.0001)
unfix 1

# Output results
print "C11 = ${C11}"
print "C22 = ${C22}"
print "C33 = ${C33}"

# Calculate bulk modulus (Voigt average)
variable B equal (${C11}+${C22}+${C33})/9.0
print "Bulk modulus = ${B} GPa""}
